newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Sri Lanka buys Jan 9-10 diesel/jet from Kuwait IPG.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka buys Jan 9-10 diesel/jet from Kuwait IPG.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) bought by tender 185,000 barrels of diesel and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel from Kuwaiti trader International Petroleum Group (IPG) for January 9-10 delivery, a CPC official said on Friday.

The 1.0-percent sulphur diesel was purchased at a premium of 69 cents per barrel to Singapore spot quotes, while the jet fuel was bought at a 99-cent premium to Singapore spot quotes, both on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Colombo, he said.
The tender, which closed on December 18, attracted eight offers, he said.
In its last tender, CPC bought the same volume of diesel at an 81.5-cent premium and jet fuel at a 79.5-cent premium, for January 3-4, c-and-f Colombo. The combination cargo was bought from Shell.
